ServiceBusQueueName.description: Primary inbound queue name. Used by bmwc-rest-ingress (send) and wms-soap-dispatcher (receive).

WmsSoapEndpoint.description: WMS SOAP service URL — resolved from Key Vault reference at runtime. For local dev: http://localhost:8080/WMSService.svc

WmsUsername.description: WMS SOAP auth username — resolved from Key Vault reference.

WmsPassword.description: WMS SOAP auth password — resolved from Key Vault reference. Marked securestring in wms-soap-dispatcher workflow parameters.

DlqAlertThreshold.description: Minimum DLQ message count before dlq-monitor emits a DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY log. Increase in production if occasional DLQ entries are acceptable.
